classification.difficultyReason: Infer combined horizontal and vertical lengths of an orthogonal polygon before forming a perimeter equation.

content.prompt: The perimeter of the figure shown below is 43 cm. Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Orthogonal L-shaped polygon with a notch opening at lower right; labels A, E, D, C and B, one unlabelled bottom corner, and all six source right-angle squares. Decorative blue fill and outline are replaced by an unfilled black outline under house style. Drawing coordinates specify appearance only, not additional measurements.
spec.mathematics: AE=3x cm; AB=10 cm; perimeter=43 cm. The remaining horizontal segments total AE and remaining vertical segments total AB.
spec.answerVisibility: All labels and givens are visible; no inferred lengths or answer are printed.

answer.short:
$x=\frac{23}{6}=3\frac56$.

The horizontal lengths total $6x$ cm and the vertical lengths total 20 cm.
answer.worked:
The two lower horizontal segments together equal $AE=3x$ cm. The two right-hand vertical segments together equal $AB=10$ cm. Therefore
$$\begin{align*}2(3x)+2(10)&=43\\6x+20&=43\\6x&=23\\x&=\frac{23}{6}=3\frac56.\end{align*}$$
